carmen: Heads-up: saw tail-latency spikes (~200-400ms) on eu-west rack18 this morning tied to several long-context jobs on a fractional dedicated slab.

lee: any mem pressure or NVLINK errors?

carmen: mem stable. node logs show NVLINK warnings & soft preempts around 09:12. scrubbed log: [09:12] pod/tenant-A: GPU soft-preempt 320ms; allocator: slab-frag=0.78, warmpool-writes=high.

anya: I thought dedicated slabs were isolated?

carmen: this is a fractional carveout (dedicated-slab-6) shared by 4 tenants. tenant-A long-seq jobs churned the KV cache and created IO jitter that affected co-tenants.

tom: short fixes: throttle tenant-A long-context at proxy; pin to warmpool-iso; add a probe to auto-shield on KV cache regen spike.

lee: allocator might have mixed latency-sensitive + batchy on same host. we should tag latency-sensitive routes to prefer hard isolation, but product will balk at cost.

anya: cost delta if we hard isolate one GPU?

tom: rough: infra GPU cost $3.2/hr. tenant-A uses 0.2 GPU avg -> shared $0.64/hr. Hard isolate = $3.2/hr => +$2.56/hr (~$1.8k/month). Conditional warmpool only during spikes is cheaper.

carmen: agreed. plan: 1) canary route tenant-A -> warmpool-iso-1 for 2h 2) add SLI alert kvcache_regen >10/s 3) auto-shield rule if kvcache_regen>12 && soft_preempts>=3.

sre-bot: deploy started: routing-change tenant-A -> warmpool-iso-1 by tom at 2026-03-12T10:02:00Z

sre-bot: canary finished: 600/600 routed to warmpool-iso-1. tenant-A p99 560ms -> 220ms, others stable. https://telemetry/redwood/eu-west/rack18/canary/1715569999

tom: adding router rule in config: - condition: kvcache_regen_rate > 12 and soft_preempts >= 3 action: route -> warmpool-iso-1 ttl: 10m (canary eu-west).

lee: add telemetry tag isolation_trigger=v1 to track cost. allocator anti-colocate change will need packer restart; schedule late-night.

anya: drafting customer message & cost note, pinging legal on "temporary throttling" wording.

carmen: TL;DR: avoid permanent carveouts unless SLA requires. use adaptive warmpool shielding + router triggers; escalate to whole-GPU isolate only if repeats >1/week.

tom: follow-ups: INFRA-9241 open for the canary steps and allocator restart.

sre-bot: ticket INFRA-9241 created by tom

carmen: thanks all, marking resolved unless it recurs today. :white_check_mark:
